newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Trade suspended in Sonae Investimentos.
newsitem.headline: Trade suspended in Sonae Investimentos.

text.p: Portugal's Financial Markets Commission (CMVM) suspended trade in Sonae Investimentos and two Sonae units, Orbitur and Inparsa-SGPS, before the opening of trade on Thursday, a Lisbon bourse official said.

The official said the suspension was linked to Wednesday's signing of an agreement between Sonae and the government which allowed the retail group to take over the state credits of loss-making tourism operator Torralta for 4.9 billion escudos.

Sonae, which has agreed to invest a further 28 billion escudos in the Troia tourism complex south of Lisbon, said on Wednesday that if the investment was successful tourism would become one of its principal activities.
During Wednesday's official signing ceremony Sonae said the investment would probably require a capital increase in its relatively small tourism unit Sonae Turismo by the end of the year.
